author: ETA PRIME
description:
It’s an ultimate iGPU showdown: Intel's top-tier Arc B390 (built into the Core Ultra 388H) takes on AMD's monstrous Radeon 8060S (packed inside the Ryzen AI Max+ 395). We are pushing these chips to the limit on the OneXPlayer and Lenovo hardware to see who takes the crown.

We test raw performance at 65W, push 1440p with FSR and XeSS upscaling, and drop the TDP all the way down to 18W to see which chip is the true king for handheld gaming. The performance gap might actually shock you!
